title: CLI command surface
description: The commands and flags a CLI's users type, committed by the CLI so a change to them can be compared with a released version. Descriptions, usage lines and examples are not part of it. This schema is protocol version 1; a reader of a later version still reads it. Lists are sorted by byte order; readers also refuse a duplicate short alias within one flag list, a null member, trailing JSON, and a document over 1 MiB.

globalFlags.description: The flags the CLI accepts with any command, sorted by long, longs unique.

commands.description: The commands users type, sorted by path, paths unique.

command.description: One command users type, an alternate spelling of another command included.

path.description: The space-separated invocation path after the program name, for example projects list.

flags.description: The command's own flags, sorted by long, longs unique.

positionals.description: The command's positional arguments, in invocation order.

flag.description: One flag of a command, or one global flag.

long.description: The long spelling with its dashes, for example --dry-run.

short.description: The single-dash alias, for example -g. Absent when the flag has none.

type.description: bool: the flag takes no value. value: the flag takes a value.

values.description: The closed list of values a value flag accepts, sorted, values unique. Absent when the flag accepts any value, and always absent on a bool flag.

positional.description: One positional argument of a command.

name.description: The argument's name as the CLI's usage line spells it, for example name or bash|zsh|fish.

required.description: Whether an invocation must supply the argument.
